name: spirality
description: Alphire Spirality — the AI development system: the shared loop that builds StarCaster, WaveCenter and itself.

scripts.clickup: doppler run --project spirality --config dev --no-check-version -- node scripts/clickup.mjs
scripts.tracker:import: doppler run --project spirality --config dev --no-check-version -- node tracker/import.mjs
scripts.tracker:signins: doppler run --project spirality --config dev --no-check-version -- node --no-warnings tracker/signins.mjs
scripts.test: node --test scripts/lib/*.test.mjs scripts/tracker/*.test.mjs lib/*.test.mjs lib/*.test.js tracker/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:secrets && npm test
